mode.title: Mode
mode.description: list = every active sale, newest first, paged. property = full detail for specific sale IDs or URLs. range = walk a block of consecutive sale IDs, which reaches sales that already left the active list. reference = check the portal and report how many sales are live.
enumTitles: property - full detail for specific IDs
range - a block of consecutive sale IDs
reference - is the portal live, how many sales

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full detail (list mode)
fetchDetails.description: List cards already carry court, enforcement agent, bidding period and announcement date. Turn this on to also get the description, area, property type, starting price and the agent's contact details - one extra request per sale.

perPage.title: Sales per page (list mode)
perPage.description: How many sales to request per page. The portal accepts up to 100, which means fewer requests for a full sweep.

startPage.title: Start page (list mode)
startPage.description: Which page to start from. Page 1 is the newest sales.

propertyId.title: Sale ID or URL
propertyId.description: A single sale ID (for example 92444) or a full sales.bcpea.org URL.

propertyIds.title: Sale IDs or URLs
propertyIds.description: Several sale IDs or URLs to fetch in one run.

startId.title: Start ID (range mode)
startId.description: First sale ID of the block. IDs are issued sequentially, so a block covers sales published around the same time - including ones that have already closed.

rangeCount.title: How many (range mode)
rangeCount.description: How many consecutive IDs to walk from 'startId'. Capped at 2000.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum records per run. The portal currently carries around 1,400 active sales.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many detail pages to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is on by default and is REQUIRED for the list mode. The portal serves its filtered list only to ordinary connections and answers 403 to datacenter addresses; individual sale pages work either way. Leave this as it is unless you supply your own residential proxy.
